main_measure.name: mean unusual move per case over 10 bars (return from signal close minus coin's normal 10-bar drift)

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day taken together

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with day-clustered t >= 2 and supporting check > 0; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2; else inconclusive; at least 30 distinct case days

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move of cases with forecast above the median case forecast minus those at or below

decided_by: Fewer than 30 distinct case days pooled over all coins and windows (12), the plan's minimum.
reading: A case is the first bet (forecast rise of at least 2 points on its side) in each 10-bar grid cell of a window, dropped when its 10-bar return would leave the window; the normal drift is the coin's mean non-overlapping 10-bar return over all its windows; the plan's 'count under 30 distinct case days' is applied as the minimum count giving 'not observable'.
